doc_verification.detail: constraint milvus_range_search_001 只覆盖 collectionName/vector 必填（1802）；dim 匹配要求在契约中无 v1 search 显式断言，其校验语义来自 insert 侧 1804 与 v2 search 1801——契约未显式覆盖该漏洞面，采 v2 search 同义校验做对照锚

secondary_observations: [insert dim=4] http=200 body={"code":1804,"message":"fail to deal the insert data, error: []float32 size 4 doesn't equal to vector dimension 8 of FloatVector"}

[v2 search dim=4] http=200 body={"code":1801,"message":"can only accept json format request, error: dimension: 8, but length of []float: 4: invalid parameter[expected=FloatVector][actual=[0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1]]"}
[v2 search empty vector] http=200 code=1801 "dimension: 8, but length of []float: 0"
[insert dim=8 control] http=200 / [search dim=8 control] http=200

http_semantics.note: 对照组拒绝均以 HTTP 200 + code 1804/1801 呈现；主观测违规以 HTTP 200 + code 200 空结果静默接受

contract_grounding.assertion_text_quoted: collectionName and vector required; else code 1802
contract_grounding.note: violates=False 仅针对 milvus_range_search_001 本身（必填项确实校验）；主观测的 dim 匹配约束不在该 assertion 域内——它是契约缺口（v1 search 无 dim 断言），对照组 insert 1804 / v2 search 1801 证明 Milvus 其他入口均执行该语义，v1 search 唯一静默。auditor 需以'一致性缺口'而非'违反已断言约束'归类
